status: Negotiated full broadcasts implemented and verified in background; overall R6/R7/R8 remain active

implementation.transport: Current preload negotiates json-v1 for legacy subscription notifications. Negotiated feed fallback snapshots and legacy full notifications reuse the redacting worker reader; public callbacks still receive ordinary object snapshots.
implementation.snapshotOwnership: Each committed event captures its exact immutable canonical text and version. Later commits cannot relabel a previous captured snapshot.

queue.overflow: Replace queued intermediate notifications with the latest complete snapshot, followed by later patches. Durable writes are neither skipped nor compacted.
queue.fastPath: An ordinary patch without legacy listeners, queued work or an in-flight full snapshot still sends immediately.

implementation.recovery: Worker failure clears stale queued messages, emits only feed/version or legacy subscription identifiers and requires an authoritative baseline. Modern clients coalesce reads and expose read failures without automatic failure loops; legacy callbacks retain their best-effort API.
implementation.lifetime: Frame/navigation scope and broadcaster generation are checked after awaits. Retired subscription sequences and stale shutdown closures cannot affect new owners. Legacy recovery coalesces per listener and does not overwrite a newer live version.
implementation.compatibility: Older option-free feed/legacy requests keep object transport. Existing getSettings/getSettingsFeed/onSettingsPatched/onSettingsChanged method names and channel names remain unchanged.
